WITH school_totals AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    sname AS school_name,
    (COALESCE(AvgScrRead,0) + COALESCE(AvgScrMath,0) + COALESCE(AvgScrWrite,0)) AS total_sat
  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
national_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_sat) AS avg_total
  FROM school_totals
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  total_sat
FROM school_totals, national_avg
WHERE total_sat > national_avg.avg_total
ORDER BY total_sat DESC;
